home.title: Give objects a second life.
home.intro: UpcycleConnect brings together people who want to give, transform and reuse objects.
home.projectTitle: A platform for a different way to act
home.projectIntro: The platform is being built around three ideas: keeping objects in use, learning new practices and valuing everyone's actions.
home.giveText: Offer objects so that someone else can use them.
home.learnText: Discover advice, workshops and events about upcycling.
home.impactText: Keep track of your actions and how they support more sustainable consumption.
home.communityIntro: UpcycleConnect brings together individuals, craftspeople and teams who run workshops and events.
home.individualsText: Give objects a new purpose and discover ways to reuse them.
home.craftspeopleText: Find materials and share projects that transform them.
home.joinTitle: Would you like to take part?
home.joinText: Create an account to discover your UpcycleConnect space.

about.title: About UpcycleConnect
about.text: A platform dedicated to reuse, upcycling and sharing know-how.

samples.workshopTitle: Repair a wooden piece of furniture
samples.workshopText: Learn how to tighten a joint and repair damaged areas on a small piece of furniture.
samples.trainingText: Learn to piece together fabric scraps to make a durable accessory.
samples.eventText: Swap ideas for transforming objects and see what the community has made.
samples.serviceText: Bring a small item to find out how it could be repaired and what tools you would need.

advice.unavailable: Community tips are not available in your account yet.

metal.title: Care for a metal item
metal.text: Clean the item and dry it thoroughly. Check for sharp edges before reusing it.

tutorials.title: Prepare an item before repairing it
tutorials.text: Empty and clean the item. Take a photo before removing parts so you can put them back in the right place.

ideas.title: Sort parts before reassembly
ideas.text: Put screws and other small parts in labelled containers as you take the item apart.

wood.title: Strengthen a wooden chair
wood.text: On an unpainted wooden chair, inspect the joints. Tighten loose screws and check that the chair is stable before using it.

textile.title: Mend a small tear
textile.text: Cut a patch slightly larger than the tear. Place it behind the fabric, pin it in place and sew around the opening.

plastic.title: Turn a container into an organiser
plastic.text: Clean an empty container in good condition, then use it to store small items. Label it so you can find what is inside.

steps.overview: Use your account menu to find requests and activities.
steps.listings: Under My listings, prepare the description and photos of an item to donate or sell.
steps.deposits: Under Container drop-offs, prepare a request and find the codes and deadline after approval.
steps.advice: Under Tips, find articles by category and view your favourites.
steps.catalogue: Open a catalogue entry to see the date, location and price of an activity.
steps.planning: Under My schedule, choose a date and view the corresponding day, week or month.
steps.score: Under Upcycling Score, see your points, badge and reuse figures.
